assertions: No successful disconnect, destroy, victim snapshot SQL or release of the document save mutex while admission is blocked.
Concurrent direct edit/delete during wait persists on recovery.
Holding COMMIT after queue recovery still keeps disconnect pending.
After commit, unload and direct reopen restore final content.
Overflow waits on actual completion without polling; active-operation errors are not retried.
limitations: Waiting flushes retain already-loaded documents and can increase request latency; the execution queue bound is not a bound on resident documents or pending requests.
Only admission rejection is retried before work starts; SQL, child-process, storage-budget and generation failures keep their existing error semantics.
No fresh real MySQL/Redis, browser/authentication, capacity matrix or deployment verification in this CR fix.
Document/cell limits remain unchanged; historical OOM and large-document helper failures remain release limitations.
